What is the tubular method?

Instead of weaving flat panels and sewing them together, the leather is woven by hand in a continuous tube. The result is a bag with no side seams: stronger, softer and more refined. Every bag is made in Italy and finished with gold-tone hardware.

Complete the look with handmade Venetian jewellery.
